item.title: A thermodynamic correction layer for machine learning interatomic potentials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sarath Menon, Braulio Sanchez Ortega, Ralf Drautz
arXiv:2610.34551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials enable atomistic simulations with near ab initio accuracy over large length and time scales. Foundation models extend this capability across the periodic table but inherit the thermodynamic description of the electronic structure methods used to generate their training data. Small errors in relative phase stability can therefore produce large errors in transformation temperatures. We introduce an additive thermodynamic correction layer that shifts phase free energies towards an assessed reference without retraining or modifying the base potential.
